## Live roadmaps stay readable by apps: `roadmap-item-shape` in the doctor

An adopting app that renders a project's live roadmap parses the at-a-glance table and the `### ID: Title` item
blocks. When the two disagree (a block whose ID has no row, a block `**Status:**` left behind after the row moved on,
a status outside the WORKFLOW §5 vocabulary), the app shows a wrong state or drops items (#79).

- **New doctor code `roadmap-item-shape`** for the active and queued roadmaps. It fails on: item blocks but no
  at-a-glance rows; a block ID without a row; a row status outside the vocabulary; a block status that contradicts its
  row; a block without a title. A row without a block still passes.
- **`softure-doctor --fix`** copies the row's status into a contradicting block (the row is the source of truth).
  `--sweep` lists the rest with evidence for an agent to settle.
- **WORKFLOW §5** documents the item block format; **§12.2** lists the new code and its fix.

Adopting apps: after the bump, run `npx softure-skills doctor`. When it reports `roadmap-item-shape`, run
`npx softure-skills doctor --fix --write`, settle what remains by hand, then `npx softure-skills state` and commit
`context/` together.
